data.one_liner: Flutter framework for building AI agents with tools and multi-agent orchestration
data.what_it_does: Agenix lets you define agents that can use LLMs, invoke tools, and delegate tasks to other agents. It supports multiple LLM providers and includes a memory store and tool registry.
avoid_when: needing built‑in persistent storage for production
requiring a companion package for persistence
strengths: tool loop hardening to avoid duplicate side effects
clear idempotency contract for side‑effecting tools
weaknesses: no built‑in persistence (requires agenix_firebase for Firebase)
larger dependency footprint due to LLM adapters
data.setup_notes: Add agenix to pubspec, optionally add agenix_firebase for persistence. No build_runner or native permissions required.
